issues.title: Cover hem band, stitch line and wing logo are hidden behind the cover plate (bug), and the cover has no grazing sheen
issues.evidence: econSeat: the plate loft runs SEC(0.575, ..., z -0.12) -> SEC(0.61, ..., z -0.111), so at y 0.586 its rear face is at z ~ -0.1147 and at y 0.5965 ~ -0.112. The hem quad (y 0.586, z -0.1058), stitch quad (y 0.5965, z -0.1061) and logo (y 0.592, z -0.1062) sit 6-9 mm BEHIND the plate since w10 tipped the foot forward - so they never render (e4pair.png: plain dark plate; y_47306 shows a lighter hem band ~13 % of the height below a stitch line and the logo lower right). Colour: e4 cover L41 vs y_47306 81-121, q16 near L40 vs 63, q16 row 2 L56 vs 81; head-on q15 middle L61 vs 37-46.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js econSeat: place the three decals on the plate's front face - z = plateZ(y) - 0.0035 where plateZ interpolates the plate sections (y 0.586 -> z -0.1207; y 0.5965 -> -0.1185; y 0.592 -> -0.1195), or better make the hem a second thin loft over the plate's bottom 0.02 m in #454c68 r 0.38. Then SEATMAT.yCover: albedo back to #2a2f45 with a sheen lobe or Fresnel lift (sheen colour ~#8a90a8, ~0.5) so 60-75 deg from normal reaches L65-85 while q15 middle covers drop to L40-48 B/R >= 1.8.

issues.title: Tick columns still random 'rain' rather than straight ribs; cancel at row distance
issues.evidence: q15 x0.63 colCV 0.093 / 0.074 vs 0.160 / 0.209; p10/p50 0.56 vs 0.44; close up e4 colCV 0.18 vs 0.10 (hero_pair.png, e4pair.png).
issues.fix: make_swatches.py synth_y_tick: straight continuous dark channels at a fixed column phase (no per-row x jitter), channel ~2 texels and ~30 % darker than the ground, pale stroke contrast cut ~30 %. Map the tick layer with u along the back width (econCrownLoft already writes u = i/n; use it instead of a triplanar blend for LAYER.yJacq) so columns stay vertical over the crown. Targets: q15 x0.63 colCV >= 0.15, p10/p50 <= 0.50; e4 colCV ~0.10-0.12.

issues.title: Petal fleck: too faint and blue at row distance, too coarse and sparse close up
issues.evidence: q15 x0.63: fleck/ground 1.80 vs 2.25, fleck B/R 2.0 vs 1.61, p90/p10 2.03 vs 2.97. q16 near crown at matched scale: 18.6 blobs per 1000 px vs 41.1, mean blob 0.35 cm^2 vs 0.19 (q16pair.png: 'snow' vs fine speckle). Close up e4 right back 0.20 cm^2 with ratio 1.91 vs y_47306 pad 0.25 cm^2 ratio 2.36. A larger, sparser fleck on the curved crown suggests the triplanar projection stretches it there.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_fleck: ~2x as many flecks at ~0.6x the area (target ~0.2 cm^2 mean, 40 per 1000 px at q16 scale), each slightly elongated (1.4-1.6:1, random angle), core L +15 % and more neutral (tile fleck B/R ~1.5). Keep coverage ~0.20. Check the crown uses the same texel density as the back face (econCrownLoft UVs / layer scale). Targets: q15 fleck/ground >= 2.1, fleck B/R <= 1.75; q16 near crown blob <= 0.22 cm^2.
